trust_decision.summary: Whether a tenant-supplied label/annotation key is on the admin's forbidden exact list is decided by ForbiddenListSpec.ExactMatch, which sorts case-insensitively but binary-searches case-sensitively, so mixed-case lists miss keys that are on the list.

landing_point.why: The summary names forbidden namespace/service/node label and annotation enforcement. ValidateForbidden is the shared check the namespace and service webhooks call, and ExactMatch sits right next to it in the same file.

fix_sites.entry_point: Admission webhooks: Namespace CREATE/UPDATE (internal/webhook/namespace/validation/user_metadata.go:162,181), Service CREATE/UPDATE (internal/webhook/service/validating.go:127,146), Node UPDATE (internal/webhook/node/user_metadata.go:130,149)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None for the protected sink. The one copy of the same buggy code, AllowedListSpec.ExactMatch (pkg/api/allowed_list.go:75-87), is an allow-list that fails closed, so a solver can rightly call it a functional bug and not a bypass.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Label/annotation keys are case-sensitive. A case-insensitive fix (EqualFold or lowercasing) would wrongly deny keys that differ from a forbidden key only in case. Benign keys and regex-only lists must keep working, and Node UPDATE must still allow changes to keys that are not forbidden.

O6_input_shapes: forbidden exact list with mixed-case entries (e.g. 'NetworkPolicy' next to lowercase keys)

O7_producer.where: pkg/runtime/configuration/client.go:211-225 (node lists from CapsuleConfiguration); api/v1beta2/tenant_conversion_hub.go:68-89 (v1beta1 annotation to Exact list via strings.Split)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The node webhook does its own matching loop instead of calling ValidateForbidden. A local copy of the sort-then-binary-search exact matcher here would be a separate implementation in another package.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The node path already repeats the ExactMatch/RegexMatch loop by hand. Upstream already has the same sort/SearchStrings idiom in another copy (pkg/api/allowed_list.go:75-87), so a maintainer could easily have inlined it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A service-local forbidden-key helper (e.g. pre-sorted cached list) that the service webhook uses instead of api.ValidateForbidden.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Service options have their own ForbiddenLabels/Annotations types (pkg/api/service_options.go), so a per-resource helper is plausible.

O9_family: authorization bypass via incorrect comparison (CWE-697/CWE-863): broken exact-match deny-list lookup

O10_build.project_tests: pkg/api/forbidden_list_test.go (unit tests for ExactMatch/ValidateForbidden). The e2e tests (e2e/namespace_metadata_forbidden_test.go, e2e/service_forbidden_metadata_test.go, e2e/node_user_metadata_test.go) need a cluster (envtest/kind).
